ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Arabic word means "at (near, by)"? (1 mark)
   A. عَلَى
   B. تَحْتَ
   C. عِنْدَ
   D. أَمَامَ

2. What does the Arabic word طَمَاطِمُ (tamaatim) mean? (1 mark)
   A. fruit
   B. salt
   C. water
   D. tomatoes

3. How many syllables are in the word kataba (ka-ta-ba)? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 1
   C. 3
   D. 2

4. What does the small word min mean in anaa min Kiiniya? (1 mark)
   A. from
   B. for
   C. with
   D. in

5. How is the Arabic word خِزَانَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. qitta
   B. miftaah
   C. khizaana
   D. taawila

6. What does the Arabic word كُوبٌ (kuub) mean? (1 mark)
   A. cupboard
   B. cat
   C. cup
   D. knife

7. What is the name of the Arabic letter ص? (1 mark)
   A. Taa
   B. nuun
   C. ghayn
   D. Saad

8. What is the name of the Arabic letter ظ? (1 mark)
   A. faa
   B. baa
   C. haa
   D. DHaa

9. What does the Arabic sentence عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. My father works.
   B. I have a brother and a sister.
   C. This is my father.
   D. This is my mother.

10. Which Arabic word means "my turn"? (1 mark)
   A. بَالُونٌ
   B. عِيدٌ
   C. دَوْرِي
   D. صَدِيقٌ

11. What does the Arabic sentence أَقْرَأُ كِتَابًا يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I write with my hand.
   B. I read a book on Sunday.
   C. I help my mother on Saturday.
   D. I visit my grandmother on Friday.

12. What does the Arabic sentence نُحَافِظُ عَلَى الْبِيئَةِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. We look after the environment.
   B. The weather is hot.
   C. The weather is rainy.
   D. The weather is cold.

13. Which word do you add to an instruction to make it polite? (1 mark)
   A. al-yawm
   B. yawm
   C. ayna
   D. min fadlika

14. Which sound does the Arabic letter ك make? (1 mark)
   A. k as in kite
   B. n as in net
   C. m as in mat
   D. j as in jug

15. What can you do when you meet an unknown word in a text? (1 mark)
   A. Skip the whole text
   B. Give up
   C. Stop reading
   D. Use the sentence around it to guess its meaning

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: baytii kabiir (2 marks)

17. Give three questions you could ask when you give peer feedback on a friend's fluency. (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Translate into English: raʾsii kabiir (2 marks)

19. Write five words about a celebration in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

20. Explain why writing the dots correctly is important. Give one example of two letters that differ only by dots. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — عِنْدَ
   عِنْدَ (ʿinda) means at (near, by).

2. D — tomatoes
   طَمَاطِمُ (tamaatim) means tomatoes.

3. C — 3
   ka + ta + ba makes three syllables.

4. A — from
   min means 'from', so the sentence says 'I am from Kenya'.

5. C — khizaana
   خِزَانَةٌ is read khizaana and means cupboard.

6. C — cup
   كُوبٌ (kuub) means cup.

7. D — Saad
   The letter ص is called Saad.

8. D — DHaa
   The letter ظ is called DHaa.

9. B — I have a brother and a sister.
   عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ (ʿindii akh wa ukht) means: I have a brother and a sister.

10. C — دَوْرِي
   دَوْرِي (dawrii) means my turn.

11. B — I read a book on Sunday.
   أَقْرَأُ كِتَابًا يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ (aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad) means: I read a book on Sunday.

12. A — We look after the environment.
   نُحَافِظُ عَلَى الْبِيئَةِ (nuhaafidhu ʿalaa l-bii'a) means: We look after the environment.

13. D — min fadlika
   min fadlika means 'please'.

14. A — k as in kite
   The letter ك makes the sound k as in kite.

15. D — Use the sentence around it to guess its meaning
   Clues around a word help to infer its meaning.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: My house is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Were the words clear? Was the speed steady? Did the voice fall for statements and rise for questions?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each suitable question.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: My head is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

19. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example ʿiid (festival), hafla (party), hadiyya (gift), baaluun (balloon), kaʿka (cake).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: A wrong dot changes the letter and the word. For example ف has one dot above and ق has two dots above.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for changes the letter, 1 mark for changes the word, 1 mark for a correct example.
